name: Ananias
description: Called "Ananias the great", son of Samaias and brother of Jonathas; a kinsman of Tobit known to him from going up to Jerusalem to worship; Raphael, disguised as Azarias, falsely claimed to be his son as part of his cover identity

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
